plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Sociology, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 2109R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/social-science-and-communication-department/sociology/sociology-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester tables print 15/16/16/13 and sum exactly. Choice slots: ELEC ANY (college-level electives, 3/3/8 cr across semesters, student choice); ELEC GE, HUMA GE, COMM GE, SCIG GE, HUMA GE2, SCIG GE2, SOCS GE, WELL GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Footnotes: Humanities courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Social Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
